The #18831 case whose fixture was #17536's heading is RE-POINTED to #16712 comment 5605768467 (same form, same release side, not an announcement) with a sibling case pinning where the old fixture went — the claim the case floors is untouched. Positive control = the battery's own `M18831_14512` constant (#14512's `Claiming`, `bare-word`, near-miss channel, card in the population) — the same bytes, so it cannot drift; the other three #18831 fixtures pinned untouched. Ablation pinned as a case: under the vocabulary alone the #17536 line IS a near miss.
